description: This Java class 'CmpMergeTool' provides a command-line utility to merge multiple KiCad component mapping files (.cmp files). It reads specified source files, combines their contents (excluding headers and footers), and writes the merged output to a destination file.

classes.name: CmpMergeTool
classes.description: A utility class providing a static main method to perform merging of .cmp files based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the utility that processes command-line arguments, reads source files, and writes the merged output.
